docs.summary: Generates .csproj files for user scripts and compiles them via `dotnet build`. User code is split into one assembly per [`AssemblyDefinition`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.Scripting.AssemblyDefinition) (.asmdef), plus two default assemblies for scripts not covered by any asmdef: `{Project}.Game` (runtime) and `{Project}.Editor` (editor-only). Managed plugins under `Plugins/` folders are referenced automatically (or explicitly via an asmdef's precompiled references).
Writes the .csproj files and the solution an external IDE opens, without compiling. The solution is rebuilt too.
Generate .csproj files for all user assemblies and compile them in dependency order.

members.signature: public static PlayerCompileResult CompileForPlayer(Project project, string targetPlatform, IReadOnlyCollection<string> defines, string outputDir)

docs.summary: Compiles the game assemblies a player for `targetPlatform` ships, with the player's `defines` instead of the editor's, into `outputDir`. The editor's own assemblies are left alone.
Output DLL paths for every user assembly that has scripts, in dependency order. Used by the assembly manager to load them all into the editor.
The defines editor compiles see. A player build uses its own set, without PROWL_EDITOR.
